title: How Freeman-on-the-Land arguments can earn you £500,000 per month!  You might go to prison though.
summary: UK barrister on the Matrix Freedom mortgage scheme, struck out as totally without merit while its operator took large fees.

assertions.quote: perhaps unsurprisingly um the claims were struck out

verdicts.note: Because the bill of exchange was not valid payment, the lender 'was within [its] rights to foreclose'; all claims were dismissed with prejudice.
In Servus v Parlee the borrowers lost their home despite multiple OPCA defences; the master waived costs because they had 'lost enough already'.
OPCA defences to home foreclosures failed in all six Edmonton files noted for 2014.
Australian Federal Court claims that Magna Carta excused mortgage payments were held to disclose 'no legally tenable cause of action'.

assertions.quote: there's just nothing in this it's just random ramblings
they were earning £500,000 a month of people signing up to these schemes
we've seen so many stories of people losing their kids people losing their houses unnecessarily
the courts have also made a civil restraint order against this Mr smart

verdicts.note: Civil restraint and vexatious-litigant orders against pseudolaw litigants are routine in UK, Canadian and US courts.
The frivolous redemption suit earns a 'strike'; three strikes bar a prisoner from filing without prepaying fees. This is a filing restriction for prisoners, not a general vexatious-litigant order.
Alberta's 2013 OPCA Master Order blocked filings and a persistent Freeman was declared a vexatious litigant needing leave to file; the early screen ended 95% of attempts to start OPCA litigation.
The High Court, Queensland Supreme Court and Federal Court each declared a serial currency-argument litigant vexatious after 50+ failed proceedings.
A leading Detaxer guru was repeatedly declared vexatious and barred from representing others in court.

assertions.quote: cooperate with the other side whether it's the landlord or the lender

verdicts.note: Courts accept realistic arrears plans while pseudolaw defences fail and add costs.
